metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.7 · 2013 · Escape Plan
metas.description: When a structural-security authority finds himself set up and incarcerated in the world's most secret and secure prison, he has to use his skills to escape with help from the inside.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 3.9 · 2018 · Escape Plan 2: Hades
metas.description: Years after he fought his way out of an inescapable prison, Ray Breslin has organized a new top-notch security force. But when one of his team members goes missing, Breslin must return to the hell he once escaped from.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 4.4 · 2019 · Escape Plan: The Extractors
metas.description: After security expert Ray Breslin is hired to rescue the kidnapped daughter of a Hong Kong tech mogul from a formidable Latvian prison, Breslin's girlfriend is also captured.
